transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve just… not been handling things well. Since the foreclosure notices started showing up, I feel like I’m falling apart. I’ll sit in my truck crying before work, and I jump every time the phone rings. I’ve been snapping at the apprentices and making dumb mistakes in the repair bay—things I normally wouldn’t mess up.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time since you started receiving the foreclosure notices?
Yeah… most of the time, I guess. Ever since those notices started coming, it’s like I’m coming apart. I cry in my truck before work and… I don’t know, I just don’t feel like myself.
Do you have trouble sleeping at night?
I don’t know… maybe a little. I haven’t really been paying attention, I guess.
Have you been feeling anxious most of the time since you started receiving the foreclosure notices?
Yeah… I have. Since those foreclosure notices started, I’m on edge all the time. Like I jump when the phone rings, and I just feel like I’m coming apart.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah… I guess I have. I don’t really go to the things I used to. Church volunteering, my fitness class, the truck-club stuff… I’ve just stopped showing up. Even at work they pulled me out of the high-risk repair bay, so… yeah.
Have you had any episodes where you felt an intense fear or discomfort that reached a peak within minutes?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I get scared and uncomfortable, but I don’t know if it comes on like that… within minutes.
Have you ever had a sudden feeling of intense fear or discomfort that reached a peak within minutes?
I… I don’t know. I get really scared, but I can’t say it hits all at once like that or peaks in minutes. I haven’t really noticed it that way.
Have you experienced any episodes of intense fear or discomfort that seemed to come on very suddenly?
I don’t know… I get worked up sometimes, but I can’t really say it comes on suddenly like that. I haven’t paid attention to it that way.
Have you ever had a sudden feeling of intense fear that reached a peak within minutes?
I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve felt afraid, but I can’t really say it suddenly peaks like that within minutes.
Have you ever had a sudden feeling of intense fear that reached a peak within minutes?
I don’t really know. I’ve been scared, yeah, but the “peak within minutes” part… I can’t say I’ve noticed that.
Have you ever had a feeling of intense fear that came on suddenly?
I can’t really say that I have. I get scared or upset sometimes, but suddenly… no, I don’t think I’ve noticed that.
Have you ever had a feeling of intense fear that came on suddenly and was very frightening?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve been frightened before, but not like it just hits all at once in that way.
Have you ever had a sudden feeling of intense fear?
Not really. I don’t think I’ve had it come on suddenly like that.
Have you ever had a panic attack?
No… I don’t think I’ve had a panic attack. Not that I’d call it that, anyway.
Do you worry about things even when they are going well?
I’m not sure. I mean… I probably worry some, but I don’t really know if it’s even when things are going well.
Do you worry about things more than most people?
I don’t know… maybe. I haven’t really compared it to other people. I guess I keep a lot of it to myself.
Do you find yourself worrying about things even when there's no obvious reason to worry?
I’m not really sure. Sometimes my mind keeps going, but I don’t know if there’s “no reason” exactly… I usually figure there’s something behind it.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things?

Yeah… lately I do. Since those foreclosure notices started showing up, it’s like I can’t shut it off. I’m on edge all the time—phone rings and I jump, and I’ll sit in my truck before work just… trying not to fall apart.
Is your worry focused mainly on the foreclosure notices or is it about a lot of different things?

Mostly the foreclosure notices. Since they started coming, I just… I don’t feel like myself. I’ll cry in my truck before work, jump when the phone rings. I’ve been snapping at the apprentices and making dumb mistakes in the bay—stuff I normally wouldn’t mess up.
Do you think your worrying or your feelings of sadness are causing you more distress?

The sadness, I think. Or… maybe it’s all tied together. Since the foreclosure notices started, I just feel like I’m coming apart. I’m crying before work, jumping when the phone rings… and then I snap at people or mess things up in the bay. That scares me.
